description: Query a Yandex Metrica table report (/stat/v1/data): one or more metrics grouped by dimensions over a date range, with optional filter and sort. Read-only. Use get_metadata first to discover valid metric/dimension ids and the account counters.

accuracy.description: Sampling accuracy: low | medium | high | full, or a 0..1 share. Use "full" for exact data.

counterId.description: Yandex Metrica counter id. Optional if YANDEX_METRIKA_COUNTER_ID is configured.

date1.description: Start date as YYYY-MM-DD or relative (today, yesterday, NdaysAgo).

date2.description: End date as YYYY-MM-DD or relative (today, yesterday, NdaysAgo).

dimensions.description: Dimension ids to group by, e.g. ["ym:s:lastsignTrafficSource"]. Max 10. Do not mix ym:s: and ym:pv: namespaces.

filters.description: Metrica filter expression in native syntax, e.g. ym:s:regionCityName=='Moscow' AND ym:pv:URL=@'help'.

fullResponse.description: If true, include all dimension sub-fields (id, icons, …). Default false: only the dimension name and metric values are returned, to save context.

includeUndefined.description: Include rows where the first dimension value is undefined ("Not set"). Default false.

limit.description: Rows per page (max 100000). Defaults to a small value to protect context.

metrics.description: Metric ids, e.g. ["ym:s:visits","ym:s:users"]. Max 20. Discover valid ids with get_metadata. Do not mix ym:s: (visits) and ym:pv: (hits) namespaces in one call.

offset.description: 1-based index of the first row to return, for pagination. Default 1.

preset.description: Named Metrica report preset (advanced); can substitute for metrics/dimensions.

sort.description: Sort fields; prefix a field with "-" for descending, e.g. ["-ym:s:visits"].

timezone.description: Timezone offset for the report as ±hh:mm, e.g. "+03:00". Defaults to the counter timezone.

name: run_report
title: Run Metrica report
